rx.title: Prescriptions
rx.nocalc: The system does not calculate doses. The prescriber enters dose, frequency, duration and quantity.
rx.override_reason: Reason for prescribing despite the allergy
rx.override_short: Please give a reason (at least 5 characters).
rx.dup_match: Same medicine or same group already prescribed in this visit:

mch.title: Maternal health
mch.draftnote: Alert rules and schedules are draft (WHO-style) and must be approved by the clinic's midwives and doctors.
mch.fp_note: A reminder date is set automatically for injectables (84 days) and can be changed. Combined pills trigger a safety check.
mch.risks_auto: Age under 18, age 35 or over, and 5 or more births are added automatically.
mch.need_visit_text: An antenatal visit is recorded as part of a clinic visit. Check the patient in first.
mch.partonote: Observations are flagged one by one. Progress of labour (alert and action lines) is not interpreted by the system: follow the clinic's labour protocol.
mch.delivery_note: Each live baby gets a patient record linked to the mother. A baby of a restricted record is restricted too.
mch.close_text: Use this if the pregnancy ended without a delivery (for example a miscarriage) or the patient moved to another provider.
mch.alerts.act: Follow the clinic's emergency and referral protocol.
mch.fpwarn.coc_hypertension: Combined pill with raised blood pressure or known hypertension is usually not advised. A clinician must confirm.
mch.fpwarn.coc_postpartum: Combined pill within 6 weeks of delivery is usually not advised. A clinician must confirm.
mch.pph.severe: Severe postpartum haemorrhage (1000 ml or more)
mch.alert.fundal_mismatch: Fundal height does not match gestation
mch.alert.dilatation_decreased: Cervix smaller than at last check (check the entry)
mch.alert.danger.swelling_face_hands: Danger sign: swelling of face or hands
child.no_schedule: The routine schedule is shown for children up to 6 years.
child.invalid_note: Invalid doses do not count and the dose must be repeated.
child.draftnote: Schedule and classification rules are drafts and must be approved by the clinic. Growth standard: WHO Child Growth Standards 2006 (0 to 5 years).
child.source_note: Doses given elsewhere can be entered from the vaccination card, in any order.
child.invalid_text: You can record it as an invalid dose for the history. It will not count and the dose must be given again.
child.need_previous: Record the previous dose first (from the vaccination card if it was given elsewhere).
child.growth_note: Z-scores follow the WHO standard for 0 to 5 years (ages between months are interpolated). Weight-for-height is used for wasting; MUAC and oedema are checked too. Children over 5 years have no z-scores here.
child.head: Head circumference (cm)
child.edema: Swelling of both feet (bilateral pitting oedema)
child.lying_note: Under 24 months, length is measured lying down; from 24 months, height is measured standing. The system adjusts by 0.7 cm if the other position was used.
child.sam_act: Severe acute malnutrition: follow the clinic's malnutrition and referral protocol.
child.chart_legend: Green: median. Yellow: -2 and +2 SD. Red dashed: -3 and +3 SD. White: this child.
child.no_chart: Growth charts need the registered sex to be female or male.
child.no_points: No measurements to plot for this chart.
child.save_visit: Save visit measurements as growth record
child.sched.note: Draft schedule in the style of the WHO EPI. Replace with the plan the clinic really follows (Thai, Myanmar or WHO). Changes apply to all children straight away.
child.invalid.too_soon: Given too soon after the previous dose
child.flag.implausible_waz: Weight-for-age looks implausible: check the entry
child.flag.implausible_haz: Height-for-age looks implausible: check the entry
child.flag.implausible_whz: Weight-for-height looks implausible: check the entry
child.flag.implausible_baz: BMI-for-age looks implausible: check the entry
child.flag.sex_unspecified: Registered sex is not female or male: z-scores cannot be calculated.
child.flag.no_standard_over_5y: No WHO standard is included for children over 5 years.
child.flag.height_out_of_range: Length or height is outside the WHO weight-for-height range.
child.flag.weight_loss: Weight lower than at the last visit
child.flag.waz_falling: Weight-for-age fell by 1 or more z-scores since the last visit
prog.title: Programmes
prog.consent: Patient agrees to be contacted about this programme
prog.consent_note: Phone numbers are shown in recall lists only when the patient has agreed to be contacted.
prog.hiv_banner: Confidential HIV information. Only authorised staff can see this record, and every view is logged.
prog.next_due_note: If you leave the next visit blank, the system sets it from the programme rules (for example 90 days when control is good, 28 days when it is not).
prog.close_text: Choose how this programme record ended. The system refuses an outcome that the recorded results do not support.
prog.candidates: Children with a malnutrition flag who are not enrolled yet
prog.recall_note: The recall list shows people whose next visit is overdue or due within 7 days. Nobody is closed automatically: after a long delay the system only suggests that a clinician considers 'lost to follow-up'.
prog.draftnote: Schedules, thresholds and outcome rules are drafts and must be approved by the clinic and the national programme guidelines.
prog.reason.cured_needs_confirmed: 'Cured' needs a bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB case. Use 'treatment completed' instead.
prog.reason.cured_needs_negative_smears: 'Cured' needs a negative smear at the end of treatment and at least one earlier negative smear.
prog.reason.recovered_but_positive: The last parasite test was positive. Record the follow-up result or choose 'treatment failure' or 'referred'.
prog.reason.nutrition_cured_needs_criter: 'Cured' needs the last two visits to show recovery (MUAC 12.5 cm or more, or weight-for-height z-score of -2 or more) and no oedema.
prog.flag.tb_smear_overdue: A follow-up sputum smear is overdue
prog.flag.tb_failure_suspected: Positive smear at month 5 or later: possible treatment failure
prog.flag.tb_end_near: End of treatment is near: plan the final smear and the outcome
prog.flag.tb_hiv_unknown: HIV status not known: offer testing
prog.flag.hiv_art_not_started: ART not started 14 days or more after diagnosis
prog.flag.hiv_vl_unsuppressed: Viral load 1000 or more: not suppressed
prog.flag.malaria_primaquine_pregnancy: Primaquine in pregnancy: do not give
prog.flag.malaria_primaquine_g6pd_defici: Primaquine with G6PD deficiency: do not give
prog.flag.malaria_primaquine_g6pd_unknow: Primaquine with unknown G6PD status: check before giving
prog.flag.malaria_failure_suspected: Parasites at day 28: treatment failure suspected
prog.flag.nut_weight_loss: Weight lower than at the last visit
prog.flag.nut_appetite_failed: Failed the appetite test: consider inpatient care
fu.note: This list gathers everyone who needs contact from all parts of the system. You only see what your role is allowed to see. Phone numbers appear only if the patient agreed to be contacted.
appt.title: Appointments
appt.note_warning: Do not write diagnoses or test results here: reception staff can see appointments. HIV and TB follow-up are never named in an appointment.
appt.reminder_ok: Patient agrees to reminder calls or messages
appt.calls_note: People with an appointment in the next 2 days, and those who missed one in the last 14 days. Only patients who agreed to reminders appear. Phone numbers are never shown for restricted records.
ref.title: Referrals
ref.sensitive_note: The summary filled from the visit leaves out sensitive test results and all HIV programme information. Add anything extra yourself only if the patient agrees.
ref.consent: Patient agrees to share this information with the receiving service
ref.consent_note: If the patient cannot agree (emergency only), write why
ref.consent_help: Without the patient's agreement only an emergency referral is allowed, and the reason is kept on the record.
ref.draftnote: Referrals with no news after 1 day (emergency), 3 days (urgent) or 14 days (routine) are flagged, and 30 days after the patient attended. These limits are drafts.
ref.consent_yes: Patient agreed to share this information.
ref.back_help: Record what the receiving service told you or sent back. This closes the referral.
ref.reply_request: Please send a short reply with the diagnosis, treatment and any follow-up needed.
ref.confidential: Confidential medical information, for the named receiving service only.
vs.title: Visit summary
vs.not_signed: Sign the visit before printing the summary.
vs.footer: Take this paper with you if you visit another clinic or hospital. Sensitive test results are not printed here.
flag.title: Alerts
adm.title: Admission
adm.linked_visit: This admission will be linked to today's clinic visit.
adm.isolation_why: Why an isolation bed cannot be used
adm.isolation_text: This patient needs isolation. Use an isolation bed, or write why that is not possible.
adm.restricted_note: This is a restricted record. You can still record observations and notes from the bed board.
adm.note_help: Notes cannot be edited. To correct a mistake, add a note of type 'correction'.
adm.discharge_help: Discharging frees the bed. A follow-up appointment is booked if you choose a date. Sensitive test results are never included in the printed summary.
adm.blood_pending: A blood unit issued to this patient has not been transfused or returned. Record it first.
adm.summary_footer: Bring this summary to any follow-up visit. Sensitive test results are not printed here.
ward.name: Ward name
ward.note: The starter wards and beds are placeholders. Replace them with the clinic's real layout.
proc.title: Procedures
proc.consent_note: If consent was not possible (emergency only), write why
proc.consent_help: Without consent only an emergency procedure with a written reason can be recorded.
proc.problem.consent_needed: Record the patient's consent, or write why it was not possible (emergency only).
proc.problem.checklist_incomplete: All three steps of the surgical safety checklist must be done.
blood.title: Blood and transfusion
blood.donor_note: Record a donor code, not the donor's name. Screening results are visible to blood bank staff only.
blood.low_note: Red cell stock is flagged low below this number of units per group:
blood.screening_help: A unit stays in quarantine until all five tests are negative. Any positive result discards it automatically.
blood.bank_note: Units are listed by expiry date. Donor screening results are confidential to blood bank staff.
blood.nurse_note: Donor screening details are not shown to clinical staff.
blood.group_unknown_help: This patient's blood group is not recorded. Order a blood group test. In a life-threatening emergency, only O negative red cells can be issued, with a written reason.
blood.crossmatch_done: Crossmatch done and compatible (needed for red cells)
blood.emergency: Emergency: issue O negative without a recorded group
blood.emergency_help: Use only when waiting would put the patient's life at risk.
blood.issued_note: Unit issued. Record the transfusion when it is given, or return the unit.
blood.baseline_help: Temperature and pulse before the transfusion are required.
blood.severe_act: Severe reaction: stop the transfusion, keep the line open and follow the clinic's transfusion reaction protocol.
blood.return_help: A returned unit is discarded because the cold chain cannot be guaranteed.
blood.outcome.hold: Results saved. The unit stays in quarantine until every test is negative.
blood.outcome.release: All tests negative. The unit is now available.
blood.outcome.discard: A test was positive. The unit has been discarded.
blood.why.abo_incompatible: The ABO group does not match.
blood.why.rh_positive_to_negative: Rh positive red cells cannot be given to an Rh negative patient.
blood.why.recipient_group_unknown: The patient's blood group is not recorded.
dash.tile.blood_low_groups: Blood groups low on red cells
dash.note: Counts only, no names. Tiles show only what your role may see. HIV diagnoses are never shown here.
rep.masked_note: Small numbers (1 to 4) of sensitive indicators are shown as <5.
rep.no_export: Your role can read reports but not download them.
rep.footer: These are aggregate numbers only: no report lists patients. Definitions describe exactly what was counted. Report titles and definitions are in English for donors. Coverage rates use the clinic's registered patients, not the whole community.
